main_body: A low green hedge or bush strip, about 32 px wide and 15 px tall, with a light leafy top and a darker leafy front
top_band: Light green (#689e63, L≈135) at rows 1-5, with a 1-row transition at row 5 or 6 (L≈106) at some columns. Below it the front face is mid green (L≈81).
evidence: The column scan shows a dark outline at row 0, then a light top band of about 5 rows (L135). There is a clear step of about 54 L down to the darker front face at rows 6-12, and a very dark base at rows 11-14. The top and front are separated by tone, so this reads as a foliage mass with a lit top surface and a shaded south face. It is organic foliage, so there are no doors or recesses to check. The top is a real band of about 5 rows against about 8 front rows, so it is not a rim-only or flat-elevation drawing.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 7 colours per tile. The references have 38-40 distinct colours and 17-20 per tile. The greens give only about 4 steps (dark outline, mid, light, highlight specks). The texture is limited to scattered light pixel specks on two flat-toned bands, with no clumped leaf shapes or per-clump shading. The outline is tinted dark green (only 4% near-neutral), which is acceptable. Overall it is clearly thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references.
